State the interval count. ⚠️ AND A GREEN requirement_state ON A FRESH PROCESS IS THE EXACT READING THAT IS ALREADY WRONG — do not clear on it. ⚠️ IF THE OPERATOR DECIDES 60s is the wrong requirement, this does NOT clear — it CHANGES, and the new bound must be recorded as a decision with the measured distribution beside it.
